TextView.android:text:
1. CALCULATING COSTS
Go to Home and tap 'Start Calculation'. Enter your mode of transport, distance travelled per day, and cost per kilometre. Select your travel date using the date picker, then choose a transport type from the dropdown.

2. SAVING A REPORT
Tap 'Calculate & Save' to store your report and view the results. Your report is saved automatically to your device — no internet connection is required.

3. LISTENING TO AUDIO
On the Home screen, tap 'Listen to Me' to play a transport-related audio recording.

4. VIEWING SAVED REPORTS
Use the 'Details' tab to view your saved reports one at a time, or 'Report' to see a summary of all saved reports.

5. NAVIGATING THE APP
Use the top navigation bar (Home, Details, Report) on any screen to move between sections.

If calculations appear incorrect:
• Verify all input values.
• Ensure a travel date has been selected.
• Confirm that distance and cost are numeric values.
• Save the calculation before viewing reports.
